product_overview: Sapiens ERP es una aplicación de gestión para una pescadería que permite administrar inventario, compras, ventas, caja y finanzas desde una sola interfaz. También incluye configuración básica de la aplicación para adaptar tema, idioma y marca.
core_goals: Iniciar sesión en la aplicación para acceder al sistema
Consultar el estado general del negocio desde el panel principal
Buscar, filtrar y revisar productos e inventario
Gestionar órdenes de compra y órdenes de venta
Registrar y consultar movimientos financieros y gastos
Usar la caja para procesar transacciones
Personalizar idioma, tema y branding de la aplicación

features.name: User Login
features.description: Permite autenticarse con correo electrónico y contraseña para acceder a la aplicación.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See the authenticated app shell
Navigate to / -> Enter incorrect email or password -> Submit login form -> See invalid credentials message

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Muestra un resumen del negocio con indicadores, gráficos y alertas de inventario y actividad reciente.
user_flows: Navigate to /#dashboard -> View KPI summary cards -> View sales versus expenses chart -> View low-stock alerts -> View expiring items -> View recent sales and purchases
Navigate to /#dashboard -> Select top products summary -> Navigate to inventory view
Navigate to /#dashboard -> Select recent sales summary -> Navigate to sales orders view
Navigate to /#dashboard -> Select recent purchases summary -> Navigate to purchase orders view

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Permite consultar, buscar, filtrar y revisar productos, sus lotes y sus movimientos, además de importar o eliminar productos.
user_flows: Navigate to /#inventory -> Search products by name, SKU, or barcode -> Filter products by category or stock status -> View the matching product list
Navigate to /#inventory -> Select a product row -> Review product information -> Switch to lots view -> Switch to movements view
Navigate to /#inventory -> Select a category group header -> Collapse the group -> Expand the group again
Navigate to /#inventory -> Open product deletion action -> Confirm deletion -> See the product removed from the list
Navigate to /#inventory -> Open Excel import -> Choose a spreadsheet file -> Confirm bulk import -> See imported products in the list
Navigate to /#inventory -> Move through pages -> View the next set of products

features.name: Sales Orders
features.description: Permite revisar pedidos de venta por estado y abrir el flujo para crear una nueva venta.
user_flows: Navigate to /#sales -> Filter sales orders by status -> View the list update to match the selected status
Navigate to /#sales -> Open new sale flow -> Review the new sale drawer
Navigate to /#sales -> Export the sales list -> Download the exported file

features.name: Purchase Orders
features.description: Permite consultar las órdenes de compra y abrir el flujo para crear una nueva orden.
user_flows: Navigate to /#purchases -> View the purchase orders list -> Review existing orders
Navigate to /#purchases -> Open new purchase order flow -> Review the new purchase order drawer

features.name: Accounts Payable
features.description: Permite revisar las cuentas por pagar y aplicar filtros por estado o proveedor.
user_flows: Navigate to /#accountsPayable -> View the accounts payable list -> Review outstanding supplier obligations
Navigate to /#accountsPayable -> Filter by status or supplier -> View the list update to match the selected criteria

features.name: Cash Register
features.description: Provides a point-of-sale workspace for processing transactions.
user_flows: Navigate to /#cash -> View the cash register workspace -> Start a transaction -> Process the sale

features.name: Expenses
features.description: Permite consultar y registrar gastos operativos.
user_flows: Navigate to /#expenses -> View the expenses list -> Review existing expense records
Navigate to /#expenses -> Open new expense flow -> Enter expense details -> Submit expense -> See the expense added to the list

features.name: Settings
features.description: Permite personalizar tema, idioma, nombre de la empresa y colores de marca.
user_flows: Navigate to /#settings -> Switch between light and dark theme -> See the interface theme update
Navigate to /#settings -> Switch language between Spanish and English -> See the interface text change
Navigate to /#settings -> Edit company name -> Save the change -> See the updated company name
Navigate to /#settings -> Change accent color and sidebar color -> See the brand colors update

tech_stack.ui_library: Custom inline styles (no external UI library)

routes.description: Root entry — shows LoginPage if no accessToken, otherwise the full app shell
Dashboard with KPIs, charts, low-stock and expiring items
Inventory management — product list, stock status, lots, movements
App settings (theme, language, company name, brand colors)

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with email and password; receives JWT access + refresh tokens
user_interactions: Fill email input field
Fill password input field
Toggle password visibility with eye icon button
Click "Iniciar sesión" button to submit
See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Shows KPI cards (revenue, expenses, gross margin, inventory value), weekly sales/expenses chart, top products, low-stock alerts, expiring items, recent sales and purchases
user_interactions: View KPI cards with trend indicators
View bar chart of sales vs expenses by day
View category distribution legend
Click "Ver todo" on top products to navigate to inventory
Click "Reorder" on low-stock items to open purchase order drawer
Click "Ver todo" on recent sales to navigate to sales page
Click "Ver todo" on recent purchases to navigate to purchases page
known_limitations: Dashboard KPIs and charts use mock data, not live API

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: List, filter, search, and paginate products grouped by category; view stock status; open product detail modal with info, lots, and movement tabs; delete products; import products from Excel
user_interactions: Search products by name, SKU, or barcode
Filter by category, stock status, product type, unit of measure, warehouse
Click product row to open detail modal
Switch between Info, Lots, and Movements tabs in detail modal
Click "Eliminar" to delete a product (with confirmation dialog)
Click "+ Nuevo producto" to open new product drawer
Click "Importar Excel" to open Excel import modal
Select .xlsx/.xls file and confirm bulk import
Navigate between pages with pagination controls
Click category header row to collapse/expand category group

features.name: Sales Orders
features.description: View sales orders list filtered by status; create new sale via drawer
user_interactions: Filter sales orders by status (all, pending, confirmed, delivered, cancelled)
Click "+ Nueva venta" to open new sale drawer
Click export button
View order rows with ID, customer, date, items, total, payment, status
known_limitations: Sales orders use mock data, not live API

features.name: Purchase Orders
features.description: View and manage purchase orders from suppliers
user_interactions: View purchase orders list
Create new purchase order via drawer

features.name: Accounts Payable
features.description: Manage supplier invoices and payment obligations
user_interactions: View accounts payable list
Filter by status or supplier

features.name: Cash Register
features.description: POS / cash register for processing sales transactions
user_interactions: View cash register interface
Process transactions

features.name: Expenses
user_interactions: View expenses list
Add new expense

features.name: Settings
features.description: Configure app theme (light/dark), UI language (ES/EN), company name, and brand accent colors
user_interactions: Toggle between light and dark theme
Switch language between Spanish and English
Edit company name
Change accent color and sidebar color

known_limitations.issue: Dashboard KPI cards and charts use hardcoded mock data
known_limitations.impact: Metrics shown are not real; create/update operations have no backend effect from dashboard

known_limitations.issue: Sales orders use mock data from mockData.ts, not connected to backend API
known_limitations.impact: Sales list always shows same dummy rows; new sale drawer may not persist

known_limitations.issue: Navigation is state-based (Zustand page key), not URL-based router — no true URL routes
known_limitations.impact: Browser back/forward navigation does not work; direct URL access always loads dashboard
